summary.text: An engineering executive builds governed agentic AI platform architecture spanning route policy dispatch and sandboxed execution boundaries. That control-plane design gives every agent action a traceable, policy-gated path rather than open-ended autonomy. Human override and escalation paths sit alongside that dispatch layer, keeping accountability with operators at each decision point. In parallel, release automation and security scanning were embedded directly into regulated modernization delivery paths, strengthening release resilience across production rollouts. Software dependency graph intelligence enables accelerated legacy-system analysis, exposes architecture dependency chains, and improves transformation visibility across enterprise complexity. That combined architecture, governance, and delivery track record underpins platform productization leadership that has driven IP-led revenue growth and expanding team scale, positioning that leadership for partner-facing AI architecture roles focused on monetizing enterprise platform adoption.
